 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Kings are coming off a 6-3 win over the New York Rangers last night, and they look to keep up their impressive play. The Kings scored 3 in the first period and got 2 goals on their first 2 shots. The Kings also maintained the lead throughout the game and held on for the win.

 Game Notes
 The Kings will still be without Alex Turcotte (undisclosed), Kevin Fiala (leg surgery), and Mats Zuccarello (upper-body injury). The Kings placed Mats Zuccarello on IR due to his upper-body injury. The Kings also scratched Jared Wright and Cody Ceci tonight.
 The Blackhawks will be without Bowen Byram (upper body) and will have healthy scratches for Ethan Del Mastro and Andrew Mangiapane for tonight's game as well.
 Tonight's starting goaltenders are Anton Forsberg and Spencer Knight. Forsberg is still looking for his first win of the season, while Kuemper has started in all 3 of the Kings' wins.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Kings have been playing much better recently as they look to get their 4th win tonight and erase the hole they dug themselves into at the start of the season.
 The Kings take on the Blackhawks tonight at 8 p.m ET.
